planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained soil in full sun; registered by Robert P. Selman in 2010, it won the AHS Eugene S. Foster Award for best late daylily in 2025.

directions: Plant divisions in fertile, well-drained soil in full sun and divide crowded clumps every three to four years to keep bloom counts high. Becky Adams, hybridized by Robert P. Selman and registered in 2010, bears fragrant orchid flowers with a pale lavender-blue watermark eye and a ruffled violet-and-white picotee edge above a yellow-to-green throat, carried on semi-evergreen, tetraploid, 40-inch scapes that open late in the season. In 2025 it was named the American Hemerocallis Society's Eugene S. Foster Award winner, the national honor for the outstanding late-blooming daylily of the year.
sources: daylilies.org Eugene S. Foster Award winners list

planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained soil in full sun; registered by Tim Herrington in 2014, it won the AHS Eugene S. Foster Award for best late daylily in 2024.

directions: Grow in well-drained, fertile soil in full sun, dividing congested clumps every few years to maintain vigorous rebloom. A.W. Shucks, hybridized by Tim Herrington and registered in 2014, produces dark red-purple spider-form flowers with a darker eye on recurved petals and quilled sepals surrounding a large yellow-green throat, on dormant, diploid, 26-inch scapes that rebloom. It earned the American Hemerocallis Society's Eugene S. Foster Award for the outstanding late-blooming cultivar of 2024.

planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained soil in full sun; registered in 2009, it won both the AHS Extra Large Diameter Award and the Eugene S. Foster Award in 2022.

directions: Site in fertile, well-drained soil in full sun and divide crowded clumps every three to four years to keep flowering vigorous. Work It Girl, registered in 2009, produces huge, fragrant, light sherbet-orange blend flowers nearly eight inches wide above an oversized green throat, on dormant, diploid, 29-inch scapes that rebloom late in the season. In 2022 it swept two American Hemerocallis Society national honors, the Extra Large Diameter Award and the Eugene S. Foster Award for outstanding late bloomer.
